harper: Quick PSA — noticed several runtime guides and a couple of KB articles returning 404 for `curl short.rwd/...` after last night's infra change. Ran `rg 'short\\.rwd' docs/` and got a handful.
drew: thanks for the head's up. drop the list?
harper: pasted list: https://paste.redwood.example/links-583 (runtime/kv-cache.md, runbooks/oncall.md, kb/troubleshooting.md, handbook/dev-getting-started.md)
xavier: i can take runbooks + handbook. small sed replace + changelog.
nina: i'll handle runtime/kv-cache.md. note: some matches are inside sample output blocks — don't modify those.
drew: pro tip: `rg -n "curl .*short\\.rwd" docs/ | while IFS=: read -r f l; do sed -n "$((l-3)),$((l+3))p" $f; echo "---"; done` to inspect surrounding lines quickly.
harper: i wrote a tiny checker to avoid editing fenced blocks: `python3 -c "import re,sys
for p in sys.argv[1:]: s=open(p).read();
 if re.search(r'curl .*short\\.rwd', s) and '```' not in s: print(p)"` — dropping in ticket.
docs-bot: Reminder: include a changelog note and CODEOWNERS mention in your PR. Small doc PRs should also pass docs build.
